entities.title: Compiler now type checks the event side of two-way bindings
entities.reason: The compiler-cli type-check block for two-way bindings previously generated `someOutput.subscribe($event => expr);`, which performed no check on the output event type. Two-way bindings are now type checked on the event side too, so build errors appear where the output event type is not assignable to the bound input property type — a case that went unnoticed when the input side had a wider type.

steps.verification: `ng build` completes without new `TS2322` diagnostics on template two-way bindings.
